# MiniMax Music3 Studio

> A Windows desktop studio for MiniMax Music 3, which sings a song from a structured caption and lyrics, running on the user's own NVIDIA card. While it is open it serves an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp that an agent uses to do everything the studio does: songs from a structured caption and lyrics, the library, covers, stems, MIDI from any track, karaoke, audio processing, video clips, the player, LoRA, and a LoRA trained from a folder of songs end to end. The agent also sees the studio's window and works it like a user.

For an agent given this repository: install the studio from the latest release, start it, connect to its MCP server, and read the skill the server serves (resource `studio://skill`, prompt `studio`) - it names every tool, what the model reads, and the recipes. Start every session with the tool `studio_status`.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; protocol 2026-07-28 stateless, and 2025-11-25 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26 through `initialize`)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http minimax-studio http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp`
- Other clients: `{ "mcpServers": { "minimax-studio": { "type": "streamable-http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp" } } }`
- Only agents on this computer and the studio's own window may connect; there is no key.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timoncool/MiniMax-Music3-Studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md): every tool by area, the model's writing rules, step-by-step recipes (the same text the server serves as `studio://skill`)
- [README](https://github.com/timoncool/MiniMax-Music3-Studio#readme): what the studio does, what it needs, models and where they go
- [Latest release](https://github.com/timoncool/MiniMax-Music3-Studio/releases/latest): the installer and the portable archive
- [Project page](https://timoncool.github.io/MiniMax-Music3-Studio/)

- Install the skill for Claude Code: save [docs/mcp-skill.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timoncool/MiniMax-Music3-Studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md) as `~/.claude/skills/minimax-music3-studio/SKILL.md`
